description: Payment-confirm traffic and latency across Router and Payment Method Modular deployments.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(${percentile:raw}, sum by (le, merchant_mode) (rate(payment_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{pod=~"${router_deployment:raw}", merchant_mode=~"${merchant_mode:regex}", outcome=~"${outcome:regex}", operation="confirm"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(${percentile:raw}, sum by (le, operation, merchant_mode, outcome) (rate(microservice_client_call_duration_seconds_bucket{pod=~"${router_deployment:raw}", merchant_mode=~"${merchant_mode:regex}", outcome=~"${outcome:regex}", operation=~"create|retrieve|update"}[$__rate_interval])))

quantile_over_time(${percentile:raw}, {loadtest_service="modular-pm"} |= "[HTTP REQUEST - END]" | json | message="[HTTP REQUEST - END]" | flow=~"PaymentMethodSession.*" | unwrap extra_elapsed_milliseconds | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (flow) / 1000

quantile_over_time(${percentile:raw}, {loadtest_service="modular-pm"} |= "[HTTP REQUEST - END]" | json | message="[HTTP REQUEST - END]" | flow=~"PaymentMethods.*" | unwrap extra_elapsed_milliseconds | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (flow) / 1000

Colored stacked series show accumulated time per table and operation; the white Total line sums all database contributions. This assumes isolated one-flow-per-confirm traffic across the selected deployments.
